{
  "sop_id": "SOP-017",
  "title": "Vendor Onboarding and Due Diligence",
  "steps": [
    {"step_id": "S1", "name": "Create ticket and assign to self", "role": "Executor", "type": "intake"},
    {"step_id": "S2", "name": "Collect registration form and statutory documents", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S3", "name": "Verify PAN, GSTIN and MSME status", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S4", "name": "Request bank account validation", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S5", "name": "Request sanctions, blacklist and conflict-of-interest screening", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S6", "name": "Assess capability and quality", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S7", "name": "Assign risk category", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S8", "name": "Check payment terms, NDA and code-of-conduct acknowledgement", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S9", "name": "Draft vendor master record and submit", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S10", "name": "Log DependencyWait while bank validation or screening clearance is outstanding", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "A1", "name": "Incharge review", "role": "Incharge", "type": "approval"},
    {"step_id": "A2", "name": "Lead approval", "role": "Lead", "type": "approval"},
    {"step_id": "A3", "name": "HOD approval and activation", "role": "HOD", "type": "approval"},
    {"step_id": "R1", "name": "Correct and resubmit on rejection", "role": "Executor", "type": "rework"}
  ],
  "approvals": [
    {"stage": "Incharge", "condition": "always", "evidence": "Approval"},
    {"stage": "Lead", "condition": "always", "evidence": "Approval"},
    {"stage": "HOD", "condition": "always", "evidence": "Approval"}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"dep_id": "D1", "provider": "Finance", "item": "bank account validation", "parallel_group": "P1", "evidence": "Request bank account validation"},
    {"dep_id": "D2", "provider": "Legal/Compliance", "item": "screening clearance", "parallel_group": "P1", "evidence": "Request sanctions, blacklist and conflict-of-interest screening"}
  ],
  "rework_reasons": [
    "Required document missing",
    "Incorrect category",
    "Amount mismatch",
    "Wrong quantity"
  ],
  "first_pass_yield_target": 0.85
}
